The institutional investor held 1.18M shares of the edp services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.26 million, down from 2.65 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Investor Ab who had been investing in Chinacache Intl Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $30.11 million market cap company.
